RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Document: EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
1. Run D-1 empty 5 min before charging (see WI-1997-02).
2. Charge 430 kg liquid epoxy resin ALTAREP E-19 (Resine Altamira).
3. Add 40 kg reactive diluent; mix 10 min.
4. Add 250 kg quartz flour and 20 kg micro-silica.
7. Fill 20 kg pails on FL-2, close and label.
New product EF-210, Part A. Batch 800 kg.
